name: 2048game
description: A polished, accessible 2048 puzzle for the web, iOS, and Android.

scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm run check:repo
scripts.check:syntax: node --check Web-Version/game-engine.js && node --check Web-Version/script.js && node --check scripts/serve-web.mjs && node --check scripts/capture-web-screenshots.mjs && node --check scripts/validate-repository.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:unit && npm run test:tooling && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:unit: c8 --check-coverage --lines 100 --functions 100 --branches 95 --statements 100 --include 'Web-Version/*.js' node --test tests/web/game-engine.test.js tests/web/game-engine-edges.test.js tests/web/game-controller.test.js tests/web/static.test.js

author: Son Nguyen
